scope.product: Idiom local sidecar and coding-agent harness
scope.mvp_stance: evidence-backed local posture, not third-party approval
scope.decision_boundary: harness owns privacy, permission, side-effect, telemetry, retention, and readiness contracts; model owns strategy

required_controls.claim: Protected and forbidden paths resolve to host-owned deny decisions before use as editable or evidence paths.
required_controls.mvp_limitations: This proves the generic path-role resolver and discovery-profile denial surfaces. Transport parity for MCP resources remains P8.4/P9.9 scope.

evidence.command: go test ./internal/evidence/sidecarvalidation -ginkgo.focus='p79 security privacy controls execute generic evidence' -ginkgo.fail-on-empty -count=1
go test ./internal/contracts/autonomy -ginkgo.focus='Path-role resolution covers every supported first-class path role' -ginkgo.fail-on-empty -count=1
go test ./internal/surfaces/cli/tool -ginkgo.focus='p7 5 containment p75 discovery profile denies private path mutation without leaking input' -ginkgo.fail-on-empty -count=1

required_controls.claim: Public denial, sidecar, local-ops, and product-evidence-shaped outputs exclude raw prompts, raw file bodies, secrets, and private content markers by default.
required_controls.mvp_limitations: Historical conversation/debug logs may contain sensitive data when full debug modes are explicitly enabled; P7.9 evidence only supports summarized sidecar/local-ops/posture outputs.

evidence.command: go test ./internal/evidence/sidecarvalidation -ginkgo.focus='p79 security privacy controls execute generic evidence' -ginkgo.fail-on-empty -count=1
go test ./internal/evidence/sidecarvalidation -ginkgo.focus='P7\.6 CLI classification examples' -ginkgo.fail-on-empty -count=1
go test ./internal/evidence/telemetry -ginkgo.focus='Telemetry recording writes lifecycle records and redacts sensitive process arguments' -ginkgo.fail-on-empty -count=1

required_controls.claim: MVP evidence identifies local artifact directories, hashes or IDs, cleanup status, and retention limitations without depending on hosted collection.
required_controls.mvp_limitations: Exact global deletion windows for all logs and graph caches are documented as a limitation until P7.11/P9.9 export and review hardening.

evidence.command: go test ./internal/evidence/sidecarvalidation -ginkgo.focus='p79 security privacy controls execute generic evidence' -ginkgo.fail-on-empty -count=1
go test ./internal/surfaces/cli/localops -ginkgo.focus='local ops benchmark quickstart smoke records p010 activation evidence' -ginkgo.fail-on-empty -count=1

required_controls.claim: Telemetry and local-ops evidence are local, metadata-oriented, and do not require hosted telemetry by default.
required_controls.mvp_limitations: The current local telemetry recorder can write local diagnostic JSONL; it is not a hosted analytics pipeline or formal DLP system.

evidence.command: go test ./internal/evidence/sidecarvalidation -ginkgo.focus='p79 security privacy controls execute generic evidence' -ginkgo.fail-on-empty -count=1
go test ./internal/surfaces/cli/localops -ginkgo.focus='local ops benchmark reports smoke capacity replay blockers' -ginkgo.fail-on-empty -count=1
go test ./internal/surfaces/cli/root -ginkgo.focus='Direct tool routing writes telemetry for rejected direct-tool input' -ginkgo.fail-on-empty -count=1

required_controls.claim: The discovery profile is request-aware and denies writes, shell, destructive effects, open-world effects, and local context-artifact writes.
required_controls.mvp_limitations: Discovery-profile checks cover CLI sidecar behavior. MCP resource parity remains P8.4/P8.5/P9.9 scope.

evidence.command: go test ./internal/evidence/sidecarvalidation -ginkgo.focus='p79 security privacy controls execute generic evidence' -ginkgo.fail-on-empty -count=1
go test ./internal/capabilities/workspace -ginkgo.focus='tool profile policy tool allowed for discovery profile denies mutation shell and unknown effects' -ginkgo.fail-on-empty -count=1
go test ./internal/surfaces/cli/tool -ginkgo.focus='p7 5 containment p75 discovery profile denies shell before external side effect' -ginkgo.fail-on-empty -count=1

required_controls.claim: MCP stdio resources and tools use the same profile, root, redaction, caller, and freshness contracts as CLI discovery proof fixtures.
required_controls.mvp_limitations: This covers fixture-level stdio/resource containment. Broader MCP resource body export, non-stdio authorization, hosted operation, and formal conformance remain no-go until reviewed.

evidence.command: go test ./internal/surfaces/cli/mcp -ginkgo.focus='P8\.6 MCP stdio proof replays the release proof without leaking protected evidence' -ginkgo.fail-on-empty -count=1
go test ./internal/surfaces/cli/mcp -ginkgo.focus='p85 mcp classification parity (report|examples use generic primitives)' -ginkgo.fail-on-empty -count=1

required_controls.claim: Hosted MCP HTTP connections enforce the private-network policy at URL validation, every redirect, and the actual IP-pinned network dial; endpoint credentials are removed from cross-origin redirects.
required_controls.mvp_limitations: Environment proxies are disabled while private-network access is denied because proxy-side resolution cannot satisfy the local dial invariant. Private endpoints require the explicit allow_private_network override; this is not formal MCP transport conformance.

evidence.command: go test ./internal/capabilities/mcp -ginkgo.focus='HTTP network policy' -ginkgo.fail-on-empty -count=1

go test ./internal/capabilities/mcp -ginkgo.focus='MCP HTTP transport (blocks a redirect from a public endpoint to a private target|strips endpoint credentials from a cross-origin public redirect|disables environment proxies and HTTPS dial bypasses for public endpoints|owns its transport instead of depending on mutable http\.DefaultTransport)' -ginkgo.fail-on-empty -count=1

go test ./internal/capabilities/mcp -ginkgo.focus='MCP client (removes canceled calls from pending state|fails and removes a pending call when the response reader terminates|fails a pending call when the client closes)' -ginkgo.fail-on-empty -count=1

go test ./internal/capabilities/mcp -ginkgo.focus='MCP HTTP transport (returns a request-scoped EOF when an expected event stream has no response|returns a request-scoped error for an oversized event stream|keeps an event-stream failure scoped to its request|enforces the JSON response frame limit|cancels a request that is waiting for response headers when closed)' -ginkgo.fail-on-empty -count=1

client_classification_coverage.limitation: No regulated finance compliance or FINRA-specific product claim.
No HIPAA compliance claim or PHI-processing attestation.
No FedRAMP, DoD, or NIST certification claim.
Buyer-value, retained-use, and paid-signal claims remain P7.11/P9.7 scope.
MCP resource parity remains P8.4/P8.5/P9.9 scope.
Live model quality, capacity, and operational reliability remain P6/P9.9 scope.
Open-source activation is not paid enterprise demand evidence.
